Check and control: [ ] C — The role and constraints of demonstration are confirmed.
Pass evidence and failure action: Record whether demonstration is required, permitted, optional or N/A, who authorised it and any time, equipment, network, security or data constraints. N/A requires a recorded reason.

Check and control: [ ] R — One declared release, procedure and expected result govern every path.
Pass evidence and failure action: Record release or corpus identifier, environment, input, command or procedure, expected output, interpretation and principal boundary. Do not improvise with a newer or stronger state.

Check and control: [ ] R — Primary and secondary paths have passed timed tests.
Pass evidence and failure action: Run under the intended access class and equivalent equipment conditions. Record test date, duration, result, deviation and the condition for switching paths.

Check and control: [ ] R — The fallback is dated, sanitised and provenance-linked.
Pass evidence and failure action: Use recorded evidence only from the declared release. Remove personal data, credentials and irrelevant system detail. Retain its creation record and hash.

Check and control: [ ] R — Reset, recovery and speaking-time limits are explicit.
Pass evidence and failure action: Define the stop condition, reset procedure, maximum recovery time and transition sentence. Do not consume the defence attempting unbounded repair.

Check and control: [ ] M — Protected data, secrets, unsafe commands and unauthorised services are absent.
Pass evidence and failure action: Inspect code, logs, filenames, browser history, notifications, environment variables and media. A protected or unsafe element blocks demonstration until quarantined or authorised.

Check and control: [ ] R — A clean-machine and offline failure rehearsal has passed.
Pass evidence and failure action: An authorised second person follows the runbook without oral repair, removes the preferred network path and interrupts the sequence. Record whether every recovery path preserves the claim boundary.

Check and control: [ ] C — Fallback use is legitimate under the current demonstration requirement.
Pass evidence and failure action: A fallback does not evade an explicit live requirement. Where substitution needs authorisation, retain the competent written decision.

Check and control: [ ] R — The incident-response sequence is rehearsed.
Pass evidence and failure action: On failure, stop unsafe action, state the observation, preserve evidence, switch once to the authorised path, bound the consequence and continue.
